description: This file implements list operations for Redis, including push, pop, insert, range, trim, remove, and blocking variants, specifically for the 'quicklist' encoding. It defines functions for manipulating list objects and their iterators, as well as command implementations for Redis clients.

methods.name: listTypePush
methods.description: Pushes an element to the specified list at head or tail depending on 'where'.

methods.name: listTypePop
methods.description: Pops an element from the list at head or tail depending on 'where'.

methods.name: listTypeLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the list object.

methods.name: listTypeInitIterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator at a given index and direction for list traversal.

methods.name: listTypeReleaseIterator
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a list iterator.

methods.name: listTypeNext
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next entry.

methods.name: listTypeGet
methods.description: Retrieves the current entry pointed by the iterator.

methods.name: listTypeInsert
methods.description: Inserts a value before or after the current entry.

methods.name: listTypeEqual
methods.description: Compares the current entry with a given object.

methods.name: listTypeDelete
methods.description: Deletes the current entry.

methods.name: listTypeConvert
methods.description: Converts a list from ZIPLIST to QUICKLIST encoding.

methods.name: pushGenericCommand
methods.description: Generic push command for list, handles LPUSH and RPUSH.

methods.name: lpushCommand
methods.description: Implements LPUSH command.

methods.name: rpushCommand
methods.description: Implements RPUSH command.

methods.name: pushxGenericCommand
methods.description: Pushes elements only if list exists, for LPUSHX and RPUSHX.

methods.name: lpushxCommand
methods.description: Implements LPUSHX command.

methods.name: rpushxCommand
methods.description: Implements RPUSHX command.

methods.name: linsertCommand
methods.description: Inserts an element before or after a pivot element.

methods.name: llenCommand
methods.description: Returns the length of a list.

methods.name: lindexCommand
methods.description: Returns element at specified index.

methods.name: lsetCommand
methods.description: Sets the element at a specific index.

methods.name: popGenericCommand
methods.description: Generic pop command for list, handles LPOP and RPOP.

methods.name: lpopCommand
methods.description: Implements LPOP command.

methods.name: rpopCommand
methods.description: Implements RPOP command.

methods.name: lrangeCommand
methods.description: Returns a range of elements from the list.

methods.name: ltrimCommand
methods.description: Trims the list to a specified range.

methods.name: lremCommand
methods.description: Removes elements matching a value.

methods.name: rpoplpushHandlePush
methods.description: Handles pushing an element to destination list in RPOPLPUSH.

methods.name: rpoplpushCommand
methods.description: Implements RPOPLPUSH command.

methods.name: serveClientBlockedOnList
methods.description: Serves a client blocked on a list operation, handling both normal and push operations.

methods.name: blockingPopGenericCommand
methods.description: Handles blocking pop operations (BLPOP, BRPOP).

methods.name: blpopCommand
methods.description: Implements BLPOP command.

methods.name: brpopCommand
methods.description: Implements BRPOP command.

methods.name: brpoplpushCommand
methods.description: Implements BRPOPLPUSH command.
